sloka: इत्युक्ताः सीतया घोरा राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः ।काश्चिज्जग्मुस्तदाख्यातुं रावणस्य तरस्विनः ।। ५.२७.१।।।।
transliteration: ityuktāḥ sītayā ghorā rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ ।kāścijjagmustadākhyātuṁ rāvaṇasya tarasvinaḥ ।। 5.27.1।।।।

translations.english: Hearing Sita's words, some terrifying demonesses, overwhelmed with anger, went to inform Ravana, who was quick to act.
